title: UDLF deployment config — SentinelOne STAR Rules
description: Config for `platform: sentinel-one`. STAR rules evaluate continuously, so there is no schedule. A Single Event query lives in `detection_content`; correlation subqueries live here.

then.$comment: A Single Event rule matches one query with no correlation; its S1QL comes from detection_content.
A Correlation rule is defined entirely by its correlation block.

Active response actions operate on a process, so SentinelOne only permits them on Single Event rules or correlations grouped by the Process entity. The inverse (response is required in those two cases) is left to the deployer, since a partially-authored UDLF config is legitimate.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `sentinel-one::0.1.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`. SentinelOne has no `Informational`.

details.description: Overrides for how the rule presents in SentinelOne. Omit a field to take it from the detection.

name.description: Rule name. Overrides the detection title for this deployment.

description.description: Rule description. Overrides `detection_context.description` for this deployment.

expiration.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), at most six months out. Unset means the rule is Permanent.

condition.description: What the rule matches on. SentinelOne cannot change a rule's condition type after deployment.

type.description: `Single Event` matches one query, whose S1QL lives in `detection_content`. `Correlation` groups subqueries defined in `correlation`.

correlation.description: Correlation rule definition. Required when `type` is `Correlation`.

entity.description: Entity that groups matching events; each maps to a fixed field set. Only `Process` permits active response actions.

match_in_order.description: Require the subqueries to match in the order listed. Set false to match them in any order within the window.

time_window.description: Window within which all subqueries must match. SentinelOne accepts only these fixed values.

sub_queries.description: Ordered subqueries making up the correlation. Rule structure, which is why they live here rather than in `detection_content`.

query.description: Subquery in S1QL 2.0. Version 1.0 is not supported.

matches_required.description: How many times this subquery must match within the window.

cool_off.description: Suppress repeat alerts for this period after firing, 1m-1440m or 1h-24h. `response` actions do not apply to suppressed alerts.

response.description: Storyline Active Response actions. Single Event rules and Process-entity correlations only. These change endpoint state.

treat_as_threat.description: Promote the alert to a threat and apply the matching policy. `false` leaves it an alert.

network_quarantine.description: Automatically network-quarantine the alerting endpoint. Reconnection is manual.

advanced.description: Escape hatch for unmodelled SentinelOne API properties. Passed through verbatim and unvalidated; prefer a modelled field.
